parameters: @alula I was trapped in there for so long...
@alula_speak Wow! The messiah really does know everything!
@niko_eyeclosed Actually...\.\. \@niko_speak I just met your brother earlier.
@alula_pout Gosh... Calamus must be so worried...
@alula Can you bring me to him?
@niko Wait a minute...\>\n\@niko_speak How did you know that I was the,\. um,\. messiah?\>\n\@niko_eyeclosed I don't have the sun with me...
@alula_speak They reminded me of the sun!
@alula That's why you're our messiah, right?
@niko Well...\. I... \>\n\@niko_speak A lot of people back in my home world have eyes like mine...
@niko_speak Yeah! \>\@niko I'm actually from another world, you see!\>\nIt's a place where the sun is in the sky and not in a Tower.
@alula Do you like this world too?
@alula_speak Yay!\>\n\@alula_pout Calamus keeps saying how this world is getting more dangerous by the minute.
@alula_speak But that's ok! You're here now!\>\n\@alula You can make everything better!
@niko_speak W-What in the world is this thing in the doorway?
@niko It reminds me of what I saw a while ago, at the cliffs...\nFor some reason, I'm afraid to touch it.
